agents-only.description: A document may define agents without a flow.

review-loop.description: A writer and a fresh reviewer loop by choice.

parallel-join.description: Two branches start at once and a join waits for both; a message selects a branch result.

quorum-vote.description: A quorum join routes on reached or missed.

join-direct-branch.description: A direct route from the origin to the join is a branch without steps.

branch-exit.description: A route leaving a branch closes the group.

branch-ends-without-result.description: A route ending inside a branch ends that branch without a result.

nested-join.description: A branch forks and closes with its own join before the outer join.

steer-in-branch.description: A watcher steers the developer working in another branch.

nested-compositions.description: Compositions may contain joins and use other compositions.

call-outcome.description: A call routes on its outcome, and a message can select it.

error-route.description: An error route can carry the error to an agent.

approval.description: An approval offers a person choices and passes on the comment.

agent-conduct.description: Plan, plan first, completion check limited to a choice, permission rules and a reviewer.

permissions-zone.description: Directories extend the zone; rules accept home and absolute paths.

flow-error.description: The flow's onError is the default error route and makes its target reachable.

shared-instance-parallel.description: Two parallel branches use the same shared instance without declaring delivery.

unverified-harness.description: A harness without a module is not verified.

approximate-support.description: Approximate and version-dependent support produce warnings.

shape-wrong-contract.description: Only the agsdl-0.3.0 marker is accepted.

shape-reserved-choice.description: step, output and message are not valid choices.

shape-call-both.description: A call has exactly one of command or mcp.

duplicate-target.description: A target appears once per route.

routes-approval-empty.description: An approval offers at least one choice.

approval-output-path.description: An approval output has only choice and comment.

flow-error-path.description: The flow's onError carries only the error.

routes-entry-join.description: The entry cannot be a join.

routes-message-to-join.description: A join cannot receive a message.

routes-quorum-keys.description: A quorum join routes with reached and missed.

unreachable-step.description: Every step is reachable from the entry.

message-path.description: Selections must exist in the sender's declared output.

call-outcome-keys.description: A call's route map has exactly passed and failed.

delivery-with-new.description: delivery cannot be used with a fresh instance.

join-no-fork.description: At least one route of the origin starts two branches.

join-shared-step.description: Branches of one join share no step.

join-entry-from-outside.description: No route from outside enters a branch.

join-open-fork.description: A fork inside a branch closes with its own join.

join-quorum-count.description: A quorum cannot need more results than branches.

composition-parameters.description: A compose step binds exactly the declared parameters and covers the outputs.

completion-check-denied.description: The completion check command must not be denied by the agent's own permissions.

completion-check-unknown-choice.description: Completion check choices are choices of the agent's steps.

result-named-text.description: A result cannot be named text.

harness-unsupported.description: A property the module declares absent is an error.

harness-value.description: A value outside the module's closed vocabulary is an error.

harness-permissions.description: A deny the harness cannot enforce is an error.

reviewer-unsupported.description: A reviewer the module declares absent is an error.

outside-unsupported.description: Denying reads outside the zone needs enforcement.

read-only-write-directory.description: A read-only agent cannot have a writable directory.

shell-bypass.description: A harness rule on its own tools does not hold while the agent can run shell commands.

shell-bypass-closed.description: A harness rule on its own tools holds when the agent can run no shell command.

effort-open.description: An effort level outside a module's suggestions is not an error.

instructions-default-prompt.description: An instructing agent's instructions become the prompt; other routes use the step's default prompt.

prompt-missing.description: A step reached with a prompt on some routes and without on others needs a default prompt.

instructions-all-routes.description: A step needs no default prompt when every route brings one.

instructions-not-instructing.description: Only an agent with instructs has instructions to select.

json-suffix.description: A media type with the +json suffix is JSON: it takes a schema and field selections.

flow-error-join.description: Steps reached only from the flow's onError are checked like the others.

flow-error-prompt.description: An error route carries no instructions to select.

name-newline.description: A name cannot end with a newline.

nested-choices.description: Completion check choices are found through nested compositions.

join-foreign-input.description: A join receives only normal routes, from its origin and its branches.

output-message.description: A message goes on the compose step's route, not on an output.

parse-bom.description: A document cannot start with a byte order mark.

join-branch-path.description: A selection inside a branch output is checked against the step that reached the join.

join-branch-instructions.description: Only an instructing agent's branch has instructions to select.

default-prompt-ref.description: A step's default prompt can only reference existing content.

delegate-match.description: A delegate rule has no match.

quorum-no-next.description: A quorum join routes with reached and missed.

shell-star-closed.description: A shell deny matching every command closes the shell.

uri-syntax.description: A URI must follow RFC 3986 syntax.

integer-index.description: An array index written 0.0 is the integer 0.

compose-branches.description: Branches that start in compositions are named after their compose steps.

compose-open-fork.description: A composition leaves once: a body fork without its own join is an error.

compose-branch-exit.description: A join branch may leave a composition through an output: its group closes.

compose-two-joins.description: A body fork starts the branches of one join, not of two joins that could each leave.

compose-error-fork.description: A body onError that starts several targets is a fork like any other.

compose-nested-fork.description: A fork on the output route of a nested compose step is checked in its own body.

join-compose-origin.description: A compose step is one step for joins, whatever its body looks like.

join-error-fork.description: An onError route that starts several targets opens a group like a normal route.

join-finish-shared.description: A step after a finish join waits for a branch still using its instance.

join-wait-shared.description: Nothing after a wait join runs while its branches finish.

join-keep-failures.description: A join that keeps failures routes done or incomplete.

join-keep-done-only.description: A join that keeps failures routes with both done and incomplete.

join-keep-quorum.description: A quorum join already keeps failed branches.

fanout.description: A fan-out starts one branch per element; the join lists them with their items.

fanout-entry-index.description: A fan-out branch is a list: a selection reads an entry by index.

fanout-to-call.description: A call receives no message, so it cannot be the target of a fan-out.

fanout-mixed.description: A fan-out branch is started with each on every route.

fanout-shared-instance.description: A shared instance in the paths of a fan-out serializes their work.

fanout-quorum.description: Each path of a fan-out counts for a quorum; the count is not checked statically.

compose-fanout-open.description: A fan-out in a composition body is closed by a join.

fanout-nested.description: A fan-out inside a fan-out path closes with its own join; the outer join closes the outer fan-out.

schema-item-bounds.description: minItems and maxItems apply to arrays, and minItems does not exceed maxItems.

fanout-visits.description: Each element of a fan-out is a visit: a maxVisits below max on a step in its paths is likely a mistake.

fanout-options-without-each.description: concurrency and max limit a fan-out and require each.

fanout-instructions.description: An instructing agent gives each path of a fan-out its own mission.

fanout-item-path.description: item reads in the element of a fan-out, as declared, and only there.

fanout-item-prompt.description: Only an element of instructions is a mission.

fanout-instructions-shared.description: Instructions that a route fans out over are a list, not one prompt for its other targets.

time-limits.description: Agent and call steps bound their machine time; an agent bounds how long a person may take to answer.

fanout-command-lines.description: A command reads its standard output as lines, and a route fans out over them.

fanout-command-json.description: A command reads its standard output as JSON, whatever its outcome; an element's fields are not declared.

call-value-without-parse.description: A command result has a value only when the call declares parse.

fanout-line-field.description: A line read from a command is a string and has no fields.

compose-output-fanout.description: A fan-out on a compose step's output route reads the body step that left: item paths, maxVisits and instances are checked as on any fan-out.

join-mixed-exit.description: A branch route cannot both reach the join and leave the branch at once.

compose-output-prompt.description: A compose step's route brings a prompt when the body step that left instructs, so a step it shares with a route without one needs a default prompt.
